status: Native service integrated; sampled ROM acceptance recorded in TESTING.md; wider route and hardware acceptance pending.

design.name: 501 Queen representative game service
design.era: Unadopted; normal-corridor fictional game operation, not current 2026 operating service.
design.scope: Eight shared platforms through existing West, Central and East scenes. High Park/Queensway, Humber and Neville Park extensions are absent.
design.geography: Preserve Queen west-to-east continuity and existing Don crossing; no King/Front bridge or new district is introduced.
design.platforms: One south-curb platform represents each directional stop pair. Smaller side streets, platform islands and directional boarding sides are omitted at this compression.
design.boarding: On-foot boarding only. Existing delivery clients and their first 43 native fields stay unchanged; platform IDs43..50 are supplemental.
design.moving_streetcars: Separate future artwork/rendering milestone; these data do not create an animated vehicle or physical track system.
design.rights: Original layout and operation; selected TTC names/numbers are factual references. No TTC map, logo, geometry, timetable or live-feed dataset is imported.

route.name: 501 QUEEN
route.normal_corridor: Queen Street West and Queen Street East; current construction diversions are deliberately omitted.
route.polyline_notice: Original compressed road centreline, not imported track geometry. Stop platforms sit 28 pixels south of it. Endpoint truncation represents this game subset, not real 501 termini.
route.coordinate_notice: centerline_segments and seams are in the 1x plan (old district ids 0 core, 1 west, 3 east); world2x.py maps them onto the double-scale scenes.

fares.charge: Once on boarding, including immediate boarding inside an open window. No extra charge on arrival, resume or save restore.

schedule.clock: Autonomous world clock, including when the route is off-screen. Paused game/map freezes the existing clock.
schedule.notice: Fictional fixed timetable: a car each way every 32 seconds. Ride time is 4*abs(destination_index-origin_index), independent of pixel distance; boarding window does not add another ride second. Fare/schedule values are design choices, not real TTC data.

stops.name: QUEEN PARKDALE
stops.platform_notice: One original south-curb game platform serves both directions; coordinates are compressed native scene pixels (the plan position, 1x, maps through world2x.py), not surveyed TTC boarding locations. Parkdale consolidates different Jameson eastbound and Lansdowne westbound stop identities; it is not an eastbound Lansdowne stop.

excluded_current_operations.notice: Sep21 21:00 to Oct15 04:00 2026 King/Shaw diversion and Queen replacement bus; not adopted.
Current eastbound York/Adelaide/Church and westbound Church/Richmond/York downtown routing is not represented. Queen/Yonge platform is a normal-corridor game abstraction.

static_geometry_review.method: scripts/check_streetcar.py checks each platform against its registered scene collisions and walking access from Union through the registered seams on every run of make check.

service.notice: Normal-corridor fictional game operation; shared directional platforms, original fare and schedule; current construction detours omitted, era unadopted.

coordinate_notice: Stop positions are native scene pixels in the sixteen-scene world; each stop keeps its 1x plan position under plan.
